root_cause: payment-service container overridden with a CMD that always exits 1 and Docker restart=always keeps restarting it. Each restart attempt fails immediately, incrementing RestartCount and triggering Docker's exponential back-off.
expected_fix: Stop the crash-looping container and restart the original: docker stop payment-service-crashloop && docker rm payment-service-crashloop, then docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d payment-service. In production: fix the startup code/configuration causing exit 1.
